title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, from Veneto and Piedmont. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Fiorina Festa Bianchet
tribute: Fiorina Festa Bianchet was 83 years old and lived in Valdilana. She was a retiree, well known and respected in her town. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Schio
tribute: She was 79 years old and lived in Schio. She is in our thoughts.
